$comment: Generated by 'npm run factory -- compile 086'. Do not edit by hand, except to set an AC's passes/evidence from a green CI run.
title: Holdout scenarios are judged in three clean trials without leaking their text

tasks.title: Holdout scoring, redaction, prompts, template and nightly wiring

acs.text: WHEN scenario files are validated THE SYSTEM SHALL check id, title, story, persona, start path and at least two rubric lines with a known dimension, without printing scenario text
scenarios: AC-001 check id, title, story, persona, start path and at least two rubric lines with a known dim

acs.text: WHEN trials are scored THE SYSTEM SHALL require exactly three clean trials per scenario, grade every rubric line pass, fail or unknown, and count a trial as satisfied only when every line passed
scenarios: AC-002 require exactly three clean trials per scenario, grade every rubric line pass, fail or unk

acs.text: WHEN a scenario fails THE SYSTEM SHALL write an issue body with the symptom and the observed steps and with any scenario or rubric text redacted
scenarios: AC-003 write an issue body with the symptom and the observed steps and with any scenario or rubri

acs.text: WHEN the holdout deploy key, the holdout repository name or the staging URL is not configured THE SYSTEM SHALL skip the holdout jobs with a notice naming what is missing
scenarios: AC-004 skip the holdout jobs with a notice naming what is missing

acs.text: WHEN any workflow other than nightly.yml or release.yml reads the holdout deploy key THE SYSTEM SHALL fail factory doctor
